title: Recall Coverage Length and the TRICARE Retired Reserve Retired Reserve Closing Reconciliation
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan: Active duty days count toward the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation only as the length of that coverage allows: where the active duty enrollment shows its coverage running more than 30 days from its effective date, those days count from the enrollment's effective date; where it shows its coverage running 30 days or fewer, no day counts; otherwise days count only after the plan's termination date.

The active duty enrollment is the purchaser's applied or active TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment; its length is the number of days from its effective date to the coverage end date (disenrollment date) its record shows. "Otherwise" covers no such enrollment, or one whose record shows no coverage end date. The outcome applies to every bill taken in.

**Boundary pair (hypothetical).** Effective date 22 May: a coverage end of 21 June is 30 days, so no day counts; a coverage end of 22 June is 31 days, so days count from 22 May and no earlier day counts.
